headline: HuyenBao v11.37 — 3D buttons, merged hero+pinzone, compact menu, 10 new businesses + franchise/sell, 7 new gigs
summary: UI POLISH + CONTENT EXPANSION. Buttons now have stronger 3D depth (gradient + multi-layer shadow + hover lift + press sink). The separate hero card and PinZone are now ONE merged sticky card — no more duplicate info. Menu shrunk (gnav .95rem→.82rem, subnav .82rem→.74rem) and the degenerate single-sub subnav is hidden (fixes the Assets 2-level bug). 10 new business types added (street food, gym, salon, restaurant, logistics, clinic, school, realestate, esports, franchise network) + 2 new biz mechanics: FRANCHISE (convert a branch to franchised for upfront cash + 10% royalty) and NEGOTIATE SELL (NPC buyer makes offer, push for more at 25% walk risk). 7 new gigs (busk, petcare, photoshoot, coding, medical, endorsement, speaking) spanning arts/engineering/medicine/fame gates. Button colour convention gaps fixed: bank Withdraw, asset Sell, Relations argue now red (.danger).
features: 3D BUTTONS: all .ibtn get gradient bg + 3-layer shadow (bottom rim + drop + inset highlight); hover lifts -1px, press sinks +2px
MERGED HERO+PINZONE: hero-v36 card removed; PinZone now carries the character detail row (job/study/rent) + health/spirit/XP bars in one sticky card
COMPACT MENU: gnav 10px→6px padding, .95rem→.82rem font; subnav 6px→4px padding, .82rem→.74rem font — fits more tabs in less space
ASSETS 2-LEVEL FIX: page-level subnav hidden when active group has only 1 sub (Assets was degenerate — 1 button above the internal 7-section nav)
10 NEW BUSINESSES: street food, gym, salon, restaurant, logistics, clinic, school, realestate, esports, franchise network — spans Services/Health/Education/Real Estate/Franchise industries
FRANCHISE mechanic: convert a branch to franchised — get 1.8× paid value upfront, 10% ongoing royalty (branch income reduced)
NEGOTIATE SELL mechanic: NPC buyer offers 70-100% of branch value; push for +10-20% (75% accept, 25% walk); accept to cash out
7 NEW GIGS: busk (arts), petcare, photoshoot (fame), coding (engineering), medical (medicine), endorsement (10K followers), speaking (5K followers + 2 degrees)
BUTTON COLOUR FIXES: bank Withdraw ×3, asset Sell ×2, Relations argue — all now red (.danger) per convention
